scope: Painted ordinary enemies, Workshop repairs, Memory Crane and Foreman Engine

rubric.note: The Crane reads horizontally with boom and hook; the Foreman reads vertically as a heavy mobile press.
Copy aiming, worker hatches and final-order jaws change the bodies while HUD phase names remove ambiguity.
The Crane hook aims toward the real source hazard and the existing copied boundary remains intact.
Boss bodies remain distinct inside overlapping red warning zones without covering the Saint.
All body pieces inherit the painted rust, brass, cream and oxidised-green arena language.
Major bodies are larger than ordinary enemies and readable at the actual camera.
Health, stun, marked and impact overlays remain outside or above the new silhouettes.
Decorative servo motion stops while state silhouette, lamps, hook and danger geometry remain.
Every reused painted source has an exact path, region and SHA-256; no new generator output is claimed.
Seven new native fixtures and render-purity tests cover the major states; no human playtest is claimed.

limitation: Major bodies reuse generated project-painted modules rather than bespoke new paintings. Human 1x recognition and reaction timing remain unverified.
next_task: Run an uncoached human 1x Workshop session and tune only observed elite/boss recognition, telegraph timing and overlap failures.
